text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, can I drop by my workplace for a second? It's just around the corner.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Oh…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We arrive to find Daitaku Helios and Mejiro Palmer with Ines Fujin's managers for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: Huh?! N-no, not at all! It's just, well… You know… Right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Right! We're, like, looking for work! Right, Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Uh… W-we so are?! It's vibes right now 'cause the manager hooked us up?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, gotcha. So… You're having some kind of work fair?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hey, I can help out with this! I mean, I literally work part-time at these places myself.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So, for example…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: At a ramen shop, your main tasks would be taking orders, serving bowls, and cleaning!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: And the trick to a good greeting is to keep it curt and clear! Just copy how the director speaks and you'll sound fine. ♪

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: The voice Fu uses when she speaks to customers is amazing! Some of our customers order extra just to hear it again!
choice_data_list: What's it like working at a convenience store?
What's it like working at a convenience store?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: You'll mostly be stacking shelves and working the register. Nothing too hard as long as your customer service skills are decent!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, and you get to speak to a whole host of customers! It's really a great way to connect with the local community!

text_block_list.name: Convenience Store Manager
text_block_list.text: And we also get huge lines of people all hoping to connect with you, Fu! That's really something you should be proud of.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Whoa, you guys! I feel like you're talking more about me than the job!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I do get the sense that the topic of conversation has shifted from the nature of the job to praising Ines Fujin's work ethic…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh! There should be one more opening too… It's for an early-morning job, so maybe that's why nobody's here to advertise it?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Anyway, the job's flyer distribution! The company I've been working for has been really good to me ever since I started way back!

text_block_list.name: Helios & Palmer
text_block_list.text: You're…

text_block_list.name: Helios & Palmer
text_block_list.text: Sooo goated!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I knew you'd been working, like, a lot of part-time jobs, but I didn't know you were such a total pro! Man, we are so not worthy of your presence!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Um, what? You're definitely going a little too far there…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Or maybe not?! Actually, I totally agree!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Maybe you should call me the Part-Time Pro! In fact… I want everyone here to revere me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm, let's start by having you address me as "Boss Ines."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! I'm kidding, I'm kidding! But still…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If you do end up working with me, I promise I'll show you the ropes.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I want you guys to have a good experience, and to make things easier for my bosses.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: With me around, you'll be pro workers in no time!
choice_data_list: Spoken like a true Part-Time Pro.
Spoken like a true Part-Time Pro.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: With me around, you'll be pro workers in no time!
choice_data_list: Spoken like a true Part-Time Pro.
Spoken like a true Part-Time Pro.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, you know it! None of that stuff on my resume is there for show.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I mean, how many top employees do you think I've already trained from the ground up? Heheh.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Wait, it's this late already?! I need to get to my next shift!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oho? Thinking about getting a part-time job, Trainer? Knowing how skilled you are, I think I could use your help.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: No, wait—you can't! You'd end up way too busy if you started juggling jobs!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: No matter what you're doing, you should never push yourself too hard. ♪

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Wait, it's this late already?! I need to get to my next shift!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: All right, you guys have got this! And I'll see you around, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Stop right there!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Like, sorry for the secrecy, but the truth is we really really wanted to discuss something with you, Trainer…
